Mr. ___ was brought to the Operating Room on ___ where he 
underwent Mitral Valve Replacement (31mm ___ tissue) and
CABG x1 (LIMA-LAD) with Dr. ___.

Overall the patient 
tolerated the procedure well and post-operatively was 
transferred to the CVICU in stable condition for recovery and 
invasive monitoring.

He woke and extubated several hours after 
arrival in CVICU.

POD 1 found the patient extubated, alert and oriented and 
breathing comfortably.

The patient was neurologically intact 
and hemodynamically stable.
Beta blocker was initiated but then held for bradycardia.

He 
then developed rate controlled atrial fibrillation and was 
started on oral amiodarone and coumadin.

He was gently diuresed 
toward the preoperative weight.

The patient was transferred to 
the telemetry floor for further recovery.

Chest tubes and 
pacing wires were discontinued per cardiac surgery protocol 
without complication.

Once on the step-down floor the patient 
worked with nursing and evaluated by the physical therapy 
service for assistance with strength and mobility.

On pod#4 he 
had diarrhea along with an elevated wbc count and pancreatic 
enzymes.
On exam his abdomen was increasingly softly distended.
His diet was changed for bowel rest concerning for an ileus.
